rules.notes: Root Sol delegates to the relevant Terra Tech Lead, who delegates to a Luna worker in a dedicated worktree.
Root Sol never inspects files directly; delegate discovery via Tech Lead who spawns code_mapper.
Root Sol delegates to Terra Tech Lead, who scopes and delegates to Luna fixer.
Root Sol delegates domain lane to Terra Tech Lead; Tech Lead coordinates Luna workers and self-verifies.
Root Sol delegates parallel domain lanes to Terra Tech Leads; Tech Leads manage isolated worktrees.
Root Sol delegates to tech_lead_frontend; lead uses ui_fixer to gather Playwright evidence and implement fix.
Root Sol delegates to frontend or backend Tech Lead based on initial symptom.
Root Sol delegates to devops or backend Tech Lead; lead investigates failure and delegates fix.
Root Sol delegates to tech_lead_devops; lead coordinates environment devops agents or Luna workers.

Root Sol must engage Tier 0 Astra Planner (xhigh) before spawning Tech Leads. Planner delegates deep research to planner_researcher (Terra max) and code_mapper (Luna low), then emits work items for GitHub issues.
Root Sol must engage Tier 0 Sol Reviewer (xhigh) to gate closing Tier A issues. Reviewer delegates diff auditing to code_reviewer (Luna xhigh) and contract checks to planner_researcher (Terra max).
Root Sol engages planner and relevant leads; do not bypass validation gates.
Escalate analysis to planner or QA lead to diagnose root cause before re-delegating.
